issues: An astrologically alleged incurable or long-lasting disease is NOT an evidence-based prognosis, and the source cannot inform any treatment decision.
Benevolent sextile/trine to disease signifiers plus moveable signs is a compound historical criterion, not independent observed patient recovery.
Fixed signs with absence of benefic support form the contrary branch, permitting long illness or near-incurability without operationalized thresholds.
Near and partile aspects are used to grade speed/ease of cure, but no time units, angular orb tolerances or real clinical results are supplied.
Lilly assigns Jupiter money/counsel, Mercury medicine, Venus magic/divine/chance aid: these are untested premodern classifications, not care options.
The source's positive cure claims also require well-fortified helping planets and beneficial sextile or trine to disease significators.
The claimed opposite rule for disease signifiers in their own domicile or exaltation offers very little hope of remedy, potentially contradicting earlier favorable testimonies.
No real disease diagnoses, persons, recovery outcomes, medical controls, chart timing evidence, or independently observed failures were included.
Printed CXXIX ends upper original PDF620; following printed CXXX on servants and small cattle begins on same page and is separate.
Only selectively anchored historical paraphrases and original images are preserved, not a full diplomatic transcription or empirical medical proof.
